title: Find the Courier
description: The innkeeper's right about the watchtower - the courier's there, at the bottom of the stair, and he's been dead longer than four days. His purse is still on his belt, coin and all. Nobody robbed him. He fell, or he was pushed, and either way the letter's still sealed in his coat.

objectives.description: Search the Old Watchtower for the courier
Take the letter - it's the only reason anyone will ever ask what happened to him

notes: Turn (per REWRITE_SPEC): the courier was not robbed - purse and letter both intact. Reads as accident or misadventure, not banditry. Left unresolved. No bible basis - local colour.
